1879052881.name: Rally!
1879052881.desc: Revives a defeated ally in combat, with their Health and Power mostly intact.

procEffects.description: DNT - Critical Heals Proc an Induction Duration Buff
Healing skills have a  *  chance to make your next damaging skill crit.
DNT - Critical Heals Proc an Induction Duration Buff

1879064145.name: Words of Courage
1879064145.desc: Restores an ally's morale over time.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879089873.name: Dagger Throw
1879089873.desc: This well-thrown knife will root an in-bound target.

1879136209.name: Commander's Stance
1879136209.desc: You focus on healing your allies.

1879138641.name: Explosive Gourd
1879138641.desc: A gourd filled with burning embers is launched at your opponent, setting them alight.

1879197905.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Lynx)
1879197905.desc: Summons a lynx companion.\n\nThe lynx is a stealthy hunter.

1879213905.name: The Sound of Inevitability (Melee)
1879213905.desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879216209.name: Resuscitate
1879216209.desc: You patch your ally's wounds, assisting them in recovering from defeat.

1879218257.name: Imp. Quick Shot: Flaming Arrow
1879218257.desc:
Nock and loose an arrow quickly.

Has a chance to generate additional Focus.

Arrows inflict fire damage.

1879221713.name: Steed of the Horse-lords
1879221713.desc: A horse meant for carrying an adventurer wherever they may roam.

1879233361.name: Ranged Resolution
1879233361.desc: Even in the face of overwhelming numbers, your resolution dismays your foes, draining morale from enemies around you and restoring your morale.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879243985.name: Cry Wrath
1879243985.desc: A vicious rebuke that calls to bear the full and immediate strength of your wrath.

procEffects.description: DNT - Being Hit reduces the cooldown of Last Stand
DNT - Being Hit reduces the cooldown of Last Stand
DNT - Being Hit reduces the cooldown of Last Stand

1879244241.name: Ride By
1879244241.desc: What would appear to be a glancing blow is actually a well-calculated strike providing you with an advantage on the battlefield.

1879244881.name: Skill of the Eorlingas
1879244881.desc: The ultimate expression of tactical horsemanship, this is a dangerous strike on its own; when enhanced by the Riddermark Discipline your ranged damage is increased.

1879248337.name: Anthem of the Riddermark
1879248337.desc: Your music culminates in a great Anthem that reveres the land of Rohan, the Riddermark.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Alters Coda: Your next Coda will increase mitigations for you, nearby fellowship members and war-steeds.</rgb>

1879255505.name: Metal and Mettle
1879255505.desc: You use your sword and staff to deliver a powerful strike to the enemy before you.\n\nWhen your companion has Flanked the enemy, this skill will restore a small amount of power.

1879270737.name: Diminished Target
1879270737.desc: Attack and weaken the tactical defences of your foe.

1879271249.name: Sic 'em!
1879271249.desc: You summon a host of companions to swarm your enemies. These creatures are wild, and cannot be controlled.\n\nSummoned companions will last for 20s before de-spawning.

1879288145.name: Determined Healing
1879288145.desc: Rohirrim can heal when in need.

1879302609.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Shield-maiden)
1879302609.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879316049.name: Recuperate
1879316049.desc: Catch your breath and recuperate. Places a heal over time on the Beorning and increases healing for the fellowship.

1879322065.name: Thunderous Roar
1879322065.desc: You fiercely cry out to all enemies around you, daring them to go toe to toe with you.

conditionalEffects.description: After using Thunderous Roar, you gain:  *

procEffects.description: Evading an attack applies an Incoming Healing bonus to you. This can only trigger once every 12 seconds.

1879326033.name: Steed of Nárië
1879326033.desc: A pony from the Summer Festival.

1879335505.name: Little Mûmak
1879335505.desc: Summons a little mûmak to keep you company.

1879404497.name: White Huorn
1879404497.desc: Brings out a white huorn to keep you company.

1879404625.name: Enchanted Vessel
1879404625.desc: Brings out an enchanted vessel to keep you company.

1879416145.name: Bracing Guard
1879416145.desc: The ability to withstand staggering blows without apparent pain is a hallmark of the Brawler's art.\n\nFor the next 15s, incoming attacks will tier up an incoming healing buff.

1879459409.name: Test Magic Tactical
1879459409.desc: Does fixed effect to test buffs and mitigations.

1879461201.name: Glory in Victory
1879461201.desc: The sight of your opponents falling before you catapults you into an empowering rage, giving you bursts of healing and increasing damage dealt and taken.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>This skill is empowered by a Defeat Response.</rgb>

1879488721.name: Major Call - Harrying Flanks
1879488721.desc: Call upon beasts of the wild to flank and harry your foe, applying the Flanked effect and reducing your own threat.

1879508561.name: Affable Grodbog Queen
1879508561.desc: Summons an affable grodbog queen to accompany you on your adventures.

1879518417.name: Merciful Strike
1879518417.desc: A powerful attack that can only be used on opponents under 20% health.

conditionalEffects.description: Merciful Strike costs more Power but restores Morale.\nMerciful Strike restores:  *

1879521105.name: Jingle Turtle
1879521105.desc: Summons a cheerful turtle to accompany you on your travels.

1879521361.name: Skulking Worm
1879521361.desc: Summons a fierce skulking worm to accompany you on your travels.

1879528273.name: Prepared: Acid Breath
1879528273.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, send forth searing acid in a cone in front of you.

1879528785.name: Prepared: Frost-spike
1879528785.desc: Send a spike of ice at your target. In so doing, you are covered in an icy shell.
